headline: Göztepe back at the Gürsel Aksel, still chasing a home win
summary: Göztepe play at the Gürsel Aksel after 35 days away, still without a home league win this season. Away it has clicked: two straight wins, 4-0 at Eyüpspor and 2-1 at Kocaelispor, and 2.36 expected goals created per game. Çorum FK arrive sixth on 13 points, with 14 goals in their last five matches. Miroshi and Sundberg are back from injury. Even so, the market makes Göztepe favourites at 43.7%, though the handicap puts them just 0.27 goals better, with 2.84 goals expected.
read: Göztepe are back at the Gürsel Aksel for the first time in 35 days, on the back of two straight away wins but with no home league victory all season. Çorum FK arrive sixth and having won four of their last five, yet the market still makes the home side the favourite at 43.7% against 30.1%, with nearly three goals expected.

facts.fact: Göztepe are the favourites at 43.7% to Çorum FK's 30.1%, with the draw at 26.2%.
facts.meaning: The side sitting 13th in the table is the clear favourite over the side sitting sixth — but not an overwhelming one, at less than half the chance.

facts.fact: Göztepe won 4-0 at Eyüpspor and 2-1 at Kocaelispor in their last two matches, both away from home.
facts.meaning: They come in on their best run of the season, but both wins came on the road — the home crowd has not seen one yet.

facts.fact: Göztepe have not won any of their three home league matches this season.
facts.meaning: Ending that run is the whole point of this fixture for the home side, and the Gürsel Aksel crowd will expect it.

facts.fact: Çorum FK have scored 14 goals in their last five Süper Lig matches, winning four of them.
facts.meaning: They travel as the sharper attacking side, not as a team set up to sit deep and defend.

facts.fact: Çorum FK are sixth in the Süper Lig on 13 points.
facts.meaning: They arrive above the home side in the table, which is why this is not a routine home fixture.

facts.fact: Göztepe average 2.36 expected goals created per game across their last five matches.
facts.meaning: They are generating the chance volume of a top-half side even while sitting 13th in the table.

facts.fact: The market's goals line sits at 2.84, with Over 2.75 priced at 52.5%.
facts.meaning: Nearly three goals are expected — an open game rather than a cagey one.

facts.fact: The handicap fair line is -0.27, so Göztepe are rated about a quarter of a goal better than Çorum.
facts.meaning: The market sees a tight game decided by a single moment, not a comfortable home win.

sources.fact: Göztepe won back-to-back away matches after the international break, beating Eyüpspor 4-0 and Kocaelispor 2-1.
Göztepe have not won any of their three home league matches this season and are aiming to end that run against Çorum FK.
Göztepe return to their Gürsel Aksel Stadium for the first time in 35 days for the Çorum FK match.
Injured players Sonko Sundberg and Novatus Miroshi have returned to the Göztepe squad, with Miroshi scoring in the 2-1 win over Kocaelispor.
Göztepe coach Stanimir Stoilov's expectations have been met after the return of injured players and the two straight wins.
Göztepe posted a "Maşallah" message calling on fans ahead of the Çorum FK match after finding their rhythm again.
Çorum FK are on a three-match winning run, beating Gaziantep FK 3-0 away and Çaykur Rizespor 2-1 at home.
Çorum FK are preparing for the Göztepe match under head coach Burak Yılmaz.
